text: The bug is on lines 34 and 40: `line.split("=")` splits on every `=`, so `parts[1]` only captures the text up to the second `=`, and then `.split("#")[0]` truncates at `#`. The docstring says to split on the *first* `=` and that values may contain `=`/`#`/`;` with no inline comments.

arguments.old:
parts = line.split("=")
        if len(parts) < 2:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: expected key = value")
        key = parts[0].strip()
        if not key:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: empty key")
        result[section][key] = parts[1].split("#")[0].strip()
arguments.new:
key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
        if not sep:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: expected key = value")
        key = key.strip()
        if not key:
            raise ValueError(f"line {number}: empty key")
        result[section][key] = value.strip()
